name: Bandit's Talent
clause: When this Class enters, each opponent discards two cards unless they discard a nonland card. / At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card for each opponent who has one or fewer cards in hand.

needs.proposedSignature: `AbilityCost.discard` widens from a number to `number | { count: number; filter?: Filter }`, so an unless-pays cost can be 'discard a nonland card'
needs.semantics: '… unless they discard a nonland card' is a cost with a filter on what may pay it. AbilityCost.discard is NUMX today, so unless-pays can only ask for a count of arbitrary cards and the card's actual choice (which card qualifies) is lost.
needs.clause: When this Class enters, each opponent discards two cards unless they discard a nonland card.

needs.proposedSignature: `Amount` gains `{ count: 'players'; who: ScopeWho; where: Condition }` — the number of the named players for whom the condition holds
needs.semantics: 'Draw an additional card for each opponent who has one or fewer cards in hand.' count:'opponents' is every opponent unconditionally and count:'objects' counts objects, so a per-player predicate ('each opponent with no cards in hand', 'each player who lost life this turn') cannot be counted. The condition vocabulary already has the predicates (cards-in-hand-le, life-le, …); only the aggregation over players is missing.
needs.clause: At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card for each opponent who has one or fewer cards in hand.
